dialogue.chat: STOP EVERYTHING — we're having a conversation! This is the BEST interruption all week, %1$s!
dialogue.chat/1: A CONVERSATION! Drop everything — okay, I've dropped everything! What are we talking about, %1$s?!
dialogue.chat/2: You picked ME to talk to?! Best interruption of the WEEK! Go go go!
dialogue.conversations: A real conversation?! %1$s, this just cracked the top three of my whole day! Okay okay — ask me ANYTHING!
dialogue.conversations/1: Yes yes YES, let's talk! I've been saving up SO many words today, %1$s!
dialogue.conversations/2: Ooh a chat! Best decision you've made all day and it's not even close! Go!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: SO good! The bread rose, the chickens marched in a LINE — a line! — and now you're here asking!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Amazing! The sun's out, the hens are cooperating, and YOU showed up — that's a clean sweep!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: So good I could burst! Do you ever have a day so nice it's almost suspicious? THIS! This is that!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Rough patch, honestly! But you asked, so it's officially turning around — that's just how it works!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: A little rough! But you asking just bumped it up three whole notches, so we're basically fine now, %1$s!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You already asked, silly! Still great! Ask a third time and it might get EVEN better, that's the rule!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice in one day?! You really care, huh! Still wonderful, now with EXTRA sparkle because it's you, %1$s!
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Best day! Okay, top three! The well water was SO cold and I only tripped over the bucket once!
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: TOP THREE day! Cold well water, a butterfly landed on me, AND the bread rose. Unstoppable!
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: Honestly? Not great! But a bad morning is just a good afternoon warming up. Probably!
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Bit of a stumble! But mornings are just afternoons that haven't cheered up yet! Any minute now!
dialogue.conversations.work.like: LOVE it! There's a rhythm, and I hum along, and sometimes the humming becomes a whole song — anyway YES!
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: Love love LOVE it! I hum, I bounce, the day flies! Somebody's got to enjoy the chores — might as well be me!
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Between us? Some days I smile at the work so hard my face aches by lunch. Don't tell it I said that!
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: Ha! Some days I grin at it till my cheeks ache. That's the secret — out-smile the work! Don't tell it, %1$s!
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s is the BEST village, %1$s! I've decided! Every fence, every squeaky gate — I love the whole squeaky lot of it!
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: Oh, %2$s! I know everybody AND their chickens by name! It's home and it's PERFECT, cracked bell and all!
dialogue.conversations.people.first: I LOVE them! Every single one! Even the grumpy ones — ESPECIALLY the grumpy ones, they're just soft on the inside!
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: Best neighbors ever! We wave, we borrow, we bicker, we make up by supper! That's a village, %1$s! I adore it!
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Anything at a big loud table! Food's just an EXCUSE to gather everyone, and gathering's my favorite sport!
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: The inn's honey cakes! I could eat six and talk through all of them! Come sit, I'll save you a seat!
dialogue.conversations.life.first: Ooh, story time! Born here, loved it, scraped every knee twice, named the well bucket — where do I even START, %1$s?
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: STORY TIME! It's a good one — full of scraped knees, best friends, and a bucket I named. Buckle up!
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: The ocean! I want to yell at the ocean and hear it yell back! It's going to be the BEST! Top one, easy!
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: The OCEAN, %1$s! I want to run right at it! It's going to be the greatest day and I've already packed a snack!
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That one morning the cheer won't come, and everyone finds out how hard I row to keep it. ...ANYWAY! Also spiders!
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: That the cheer runs out one morning and everyone sees how hard I paddle underneath. ...ANYWAY! Look, a bird!
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: You're top three, %1$s! People-wise! Okay, fine, top ONE. Don't make it weird, I have chores!
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: You're my top ONE, %1$s! I said it! No takebacks! Okay now I HAVE to go rake something, this is a lot!
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: Ooh, big question! Too big for now! But keep coming around and I will absolutely overshare someday, promise!
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: Ooh, that's a big-shelf question! Not yet! But stick around and I will overshare SO hard someday, promise!
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: That one lives on the bottom shelf of the heart! We're still up top — great shelf! — but keep climbing, %1$s!
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: Bottom shelf of the heart, that one! We're on a great shelf right now though! Keep climbing, %1$s!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing new! A chicken sat on the fence for a whole HOUR though. I watched all of it. Riveting stuff!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Nothing! Well — a duck walked through the market like it OWNED the place. I clapped. Nobody joined me. Their loss!
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy?! %1$s, you're my top one of EVERYTHING! I hum your name at the chickens! ...I've said too much! YES!
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: SO happy I made the well echo it back! You're the best thing that ever happened to me, no takebacks, YES!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage: %2$s and %3$s got MARRIED, %1$s! A wedding! I cried, I cheered, I ate three slices of cake — best day EVER!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage/1: Did you HEAR?! %2$s and %3$s tied the knot! I've never clapped so hard! Love wins, the cake was perfect, everything's wonderful!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce: Aw, %2$s and %3$s split up. That's a sad one! But you know what? Both of them are gonna be SO okay, I just know it!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce/1: %2$s and %3$s aren't together anymore, poor dears. Hearts are tough though — they bounce back, and I'll be cheering for both of them!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: Oh, %1$s... %2$s passed away. I know, I know. But what a bright light they were! Let's remember the good, every last sparkle of it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/1: We lost dear %2$s. It hurts, it really does. But oh, the SMILES that one gave this village! I'll hold onto every one.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: A BABY! %2$s had a baby, %1$s! A brand-new tiny person! I already made them a little hat! Best news of the WEEK!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/1: %2$s had a baby!! Ten tiny fingers, ten tiny toes, I counted TWICE! The whole village is glowing! I might just burst!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival: Someone new moved in — %2$s! A NEW friend, %1$s! I've already planned the welcome basket AND the welcome song! Come meet them!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival/1: %2$s just moved to the village! Fresh face, fresh friend! I waved so hard I nearly fell in the well! So exciting!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure: Aw, %2$s moved away for good. I'll miss them SO much! But new adventures, right? I made them promise to write!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure/: %2$s packed up and left, %1$s. Bittersweet! I gave them the biggest hug goodbye — the whole village did! Go be amazing out there!
dialogue.chatmode.confused: Ooh, you lost me! Say it another way?
dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Hehe, what was that? Try again!
dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: We could chat about %2$s — so fun!
dialogue.chatmode.clarify/1: Do you mean %2$s or %3$s? Tell me tell me!
dialogue.chatmode.busy: One sec, super busy right now!
